messages:
Sophie (Customer): hey — running into a problem with /v1/rerank. We send a long query (~12k chars) + ~80 docs (~2k chars each) and get back 'Payload too large' and a 413. No breakdown in the body, just a generic message. Can you help?

Maya (Support): sorry you're blocked — can you paste the request id or the full curl you used so we can repro? Also which model/endpoint params (passages vs documents)?

Sophie (Customer): request id: req_2026-03-16-07. Here is a redacted curl (api key redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"<long query, ~12000 chars>","documents":[{"id":"d1","text":"<~2000 chars>"}, {"id":"d2","text":"<~2000 chars>"}, ... up to 80 docs]}'
```

Maya (Support): thanks. Initial guess: this is hitting the service-side token/char ceiling for rerank (we sum tokens across query + all docs). Can you try with a smaller doc subset (e.g., 10 docs) and confirm? Also, which client language/SDK are you using?

Sophie (Customer): Node SDK, but we tried curl to rule that out. Reducing to 10 docs returns success (scores back), so looks like aggregate size is the issue. But two asks: 1) can the error be more actionable? 413 "Payload too large" doesn't say which field pushed it over. 2) any recommended server-side workaround?

Ajay (Eng): quick context: rerank currently enforces a token ceiling of 65536 tokens (sum of tokenized query + all documents). The endpoint returns 413 without per-field counts — we should definitely surface a structured error: e.g. "error: token_limit_exceeded; limit=65536; request_total_tokens=98721; query_tokens=345; docs_tokens=98376". That would make triage and client-side fallbacks straightforward.

Ajay (Eng): workaround options:
- only send top-K candidates from retrieval (K=10-20) to rerank, then expand if needed.
- send shortened snippets per doc (extract a 500-800 char snippet) instead of whole doc.
- run an embedding-based filter first (embed docs + query, get top matches, then rerank those).
- chunk large documents and rerank per-chunk, merge scores heuristically.

Maya (Support): helpful — can you add a short repro checklist we can hand back to the customer and include a suggested client-side mitigation snippet?

Ajay (Eng): sure — put this in support reply: 
1) Repro steps to confirm limit:
   - Run the same curl with a small doc subset (10 docs) -> expect 200.
   - Run original payload -> 413.
   - Call internal tokenizer endpoint to get token counts (example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tokenize \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text":"<your full request payload concatenated>"}'
```
   - Verify sum(tokens(query) + sum(tokens(docs))) > 65536

2) Short-term mitigation to send in support note:
   - Reduce candidate docs to 10-20 before calling rerank.
   - Include only snippet fields: "documents:[{id,text_snippet}\] " (500-800 chars)
   - If you need full-doc rerank, do embedding filter -> rerank top candidates.

3) Example patch for client that auto-falls back:
```js
// pseudocode
const candidates = retrieve(query);
if (estimatedTokens(query, candidates) > 65000) {
  const snippets = candidates.slice(0, 20).map(d => ({id: d.id, text: d.snippet}));
  return rerank(query, snippets);
} else {
  return rerank(query, candidates);
}
```

Maya (Support): adding a KB ticket and will recommend we surface structured error details instead of generic 413. @product — can we prioritise error message improvement + doc examples? :pray:

OpsBot: created ticket SUP-9832 assigned to product.

Sophie (Customer): thanks — that workaround will work for now. Would appreciate clearer error payloads in the API so we can automate fallback. :heart:

Maya (Support): thanks for reporting, Sophie. I'll follow up once product confirms ETA on the error payload change. In the meantime, I'll send the snippet/embedding patterns as explicit examples in the support article. :+1:
